summary.zh: 在接单之前判断能力，把生产计划与交付承诺绑定。
summary.en: Assess capacity before accepting an order that binds planning to a deadline.

rules.zh: 玩家从委托中选择一项，确认数量、质量或收集条件及期限。完成制作和交付领取报酬；接得太满可能让材料、设备或日程互相冲突。
rules.en: Choose an order with quantity, quality or collection conditions and a deadline. Produce and deliver for payment; overcommitment creates conflicts in materials, equipment or schedules.

decisions.zh: 高报酬难单和低风险小单，哪个更适合当前产能？
decisions.en: Take a lucrative challenge or a safe small order?

decisions.zh: 为赶单买材料，会不会让利润消失？
decisions.en: Will buying materials to rush erase the margin?

effect.zh: 短期限强调排程，长期限强调跨日资源配置。
effect.en: Short deadlines emphasize scheduling; long ones emphasize resource allocation.

effect.zh: 只损失机会鼓励尝试，扣信誉则要求更谨慎接单。
effect.en: Lost opportunity encourages trying; reputation penalties demand caution.

implementation.zh: 商会委托要求在期限内交付指定物品，完成后获得金钱、工坊声望及委托人关系收益。
implementation.en: Commerce Guild commissions require specified items by a deadline and reward money, workshop reputation and client relationship gains.

observation.zh: 系统参考图：制作图纸明确材料前置要求；委托时限和报酬不在这张图中。
observation.en: System reference: assembly diagrams expose material prerequisites; commission deadlines and rewards are not shown.

implementation.zh: 特别订单可能同时要求新采集的物品与交付，任务有各自期限和奖励；库存不总能直接满足全部目标。
implementation.en: Special Orders can require newly collected items as well as delivery, with order-specific deadlines and rewards; stored goods do not always satisfy every objective.

observation.zh: 系统参考图：农场作物与设备展示潜在交付产能；本图不是特别订单面板。
observation.en: System reference: crops and equipment suggest delivery capacity; this is not the Special Orders panel.

contrast.zh: 波西亚将订单接到工坊成长；星露谷特别订单常改变一段时间里的活动重点。
contrast.en: Portia connects contracts to workshop growth; Stardew’s Special Orders redirect activities over a period.

combination.zh: 组合创意：接受节日烟花订单后必须安排多段生产，若早交可让居民提前布置街区，反馈不只是一笔钱。
combination.en: Design proposal: a festival fireworks order requires several production stages; early delivery lets residents decorate sooner, offering visible feedback beyond money.

setup.zh: 委托要求两天内交六把工具，你每天只能做四把，还缺部分材料。
setup.en: A contract needs six tools in two days; daily capacity is four and some materials are missing.

action.zh: 你先算材料与生产时间，确认能完成后接单并安排采购。
action.en: Check materials and production time, then accept and schedule purchases.

result.zh: 生产占用了设备，但交付后获得报酬；其他订单必须等待。
result.en: Production occupies equipment, while delivery pays out and other jobs wait.

next.zh: 结算剩余材料与可用时间，再选择下一张订单。
next.en: Review remaining materials and time before selecting the next contract.

firstStep.zh: 做两台设备、三张不同期限订单和可查看的每日生产表。
firstStep.en: Build two machines, three deadlines, and a visible daily production schedule.

pitfall.zh: 别靠突然改变期限制造难度；让玩家接单前就能看到主要约束。
pitfall.en: Avoid surprise deadline changes; expose the main constraints before acceptance.

test.zh: 提供一张报酬高但做不完的订单，观察玩家是否主动拒绝。
test.en: Offer a lucrative but infeasible contract and see whether players reject it.
